user.title: Manual authentication
user.description: This experimental setup currently requires credentials copied locally from an authenticated Sunny Portal browser session. The refresh token is stored privately and is never shown again.

data_description.plant_id: Numeric identifier shown in Sunny Portal API request URLs.
data_description.refresh_token: Newest rotating refresh token from the authenticated browser session. Never share this value.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Sunny Portal rejected the stored session. Enter a new refresh token copied locally from a newly authenticated browser session.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to SMA Sunny Portal.
error.invalid_auth: Sunny Portal rejected the refresh token.
error.invalid_plant_id: Enter the numeric plant ID from the Sunny Portal API request URL.
error.invalid_refresh_token: Enter a non-empty refresh token without whitespace.
error.invalid_response: Sunny Portal returned data in an unsupported format.
error.rate_limited: Sunny Portal temporarily rate-limited the request. Try again later.
error.storage_error: The rotated refresh token could not be stored safely.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating Sunny Portal.

abort.already_configured: This SMA account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The new token belongs to a different SMA account.
